title: Why Is the Sea Salty? The Surprising Answer Starts With Rain
short_title: Rivers are fresh… so why is the sea salty? 🌊 #shorts
description:
Rain is fresh. Rivers are fresh. So where does all the salt in the ocean come from? The answer begins with rain, rocks and a lot of time. Here is the journey of a grain of salt, step by step.

{CHAPITRES}

Subscribe to Factora so you never miss a fascinating fact.

Sources: NOAA National Ocean Service ('Why is the ocean salty?', salt layer over land); USGS Water Science School (rock weathering, dissolved minerals carried by rivers); NOAA / Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution (hydrothermal vents, ocean salinity ~35 g per liter); Encyclopaedia Britannica (seawater composition, Dead Sea salinity).
